facts.fact: The UNESCO-commissioned case study (Szucs), researched in late 2019, states that schools keep registers on paper, some worn or kept in teachers' houses, that attendance of students and teachers is collected at school but not stored centrally, and that more often than not there are no computers at school or woreda level.
facts.system: school registers (paper; no learner-record system at the school)

facts.fact: UNHCR was piloting its Digital Education Platform in late 2019, registering each child in refugee camp schools by registration card every semester, with rollout to all camps expected in early 2020; it covers refugee camp schools only and no count of schools is given.

Under UNHCR's Digital Education Platform each child is registered in the database once a semester by reading a registration card at the school or camp, linked to the refugee registration profile; the study describes this as at late 2019, in refugee camps only.

The Digital Education Platform is UNHCR's, with dashboards to be opened to the Government and partners through a portal under procedures still to be set, and its relation to the ministry's EMIS not yet clarified, as at late 2019.

systems.platform: paper questionnaire of about 25 pages for primary schools; StatEduc2 (UIS) and Excel for entry
systems.owner: Ministry of Education (EMIS and ICT Directorate); regional education bureaux
systems.tiers: filled at school by the principal once a year, stamped by the woreda, keyed at the regional bureau, compiled federally

systems.platform: the same questionnaire in soft copy; Excel
systems.owner: ARRA and UNHCR, with the Ministry of Education
systems.tiers: refugee camp schools; keyed at ARRA zonal offices, sent to regional bureaux and the federal EMIS Directorate

systems.platform: computers at local level connected by internet to a central database
systems.tiers: piloted successfully; national rollout in question and adaptations under consideration; intended to link to EMIS and replace the annual school census

systems.country_label: Education Management Information System Action Plan
systems.platform: tablets, SMS where there is no internet, central server
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, drafted with FHI360 for the British Council
systems.tiers: planned for primary and secondary schools, woreda, zone, region and federal levels; no resources to put it into practice

systems.platform: registration-card readers linked to UNHCR Level 3 registration
systems.tiers: refugee camp schools; pilot, rollout to all camps expected early 2020
coverage of teachers not available at the ESDP V mid-term review
coordinates available for most schools; not integrated with EMIS

systems.system: Monthly school surveys and start-of-year enrolment returns
systems.tiers: enrolment by gender and age after registration; monthly counts of students and teachers, reported quarterly to regional councils

systems.system: Education Cluster mobile data collection pilot
systems.tiers: woreda EMIS officers keying paper school questionnaires quarterly; not sustained

note: SMIS and the tablet-based Action Plan are left unclassified: the study says SMIS is piloted, school-based and meant to replace the census, and that the Action Plan would report attendance and dropout as often as needed, but it does not say either holds a record per learner. If the parent classes SMIS as emis, the fact it gives is schools:pilot as at 2019.
